_meta.purpose: Look settings for the Quick Quiz swatch cards (docs/SWATCH_ROOMS_PLAN.md).
_meta.strip: The colour of the strip holding the question: 'yellow' (the brand yellow with dark text) or 'navy' (the brand navy with off-white text, Jaida 2026-11-22). Switch here to compare; save and refresh the page.
_meta.embedMinHeight: Inside the website's iframe only (/embed-test), the quiz is at least this tall, in pixels: 'phone' below 640px wide, 'computer' from 640px wide. Shorter cards leave space above the buttons instead of shrinking the iframe (Jaida, 2026-11-22). Set to null to let the iframe fit each card again. Set just above the tallest card, measured in Chrome on 2026-11-23 with the wide room and the footer: 703px on a 375px-wide phone (the same on short and tall phones), 947px on a computer (the iframe 736px wide). Narrower phones wrap more text, so their cards are taller.
_meta.roomWidth: How wide the room above the bar is, as a percentage of the bar's width: 'phone' below 640px wide, 'computer' from 640px wide (Jaida, 2026-11-23). The wide (3:1) room stays low, so it can be wide. Change the numbers to try other widths; then check the iframe minimum heights still hold.
